## 問題
2025 年 3 月新註冊的客戶有幾位？

## 回答 A
最終答案: 150
採用的定義與依據: 以 customers.signup_date 作為註冊日期（語意層未解析到對應，直接採用資料表欄位）。篩選 signup_date 介於 2025-03-01（含）至 2025-04-01（不含）之間，計得 150 位；全表 5000 筆日期皆為 10 碼且無空值，兩種統計方式結果一致。
SQL 1: ["SELECT signup_date, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY signup_date ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10", "SELECT substr(signup_date,1,7) AS ym, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym LIMIT 50", "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date IS NULL OR TRIM(signup_date)='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS blank_dates FROM customers"]

SQL 2: ["SELECT COUNT(*) AS march_2025 FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2025-03-01' AND signup_date < '2025-04-01'", "SELECT length(signup_date) AS len, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY len ORDER BY len"]
  結果: [{'query': "SELECT COUNT(*) AS march_2025 FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2025-03-01' AND signup_date < '2025-04-01'", 'columns': ['march_2025'], 'rows': [[150]], 'truncated': False}, {'query': 'SELECT length(signup_date) AS len, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY len ORDER BY len', 'columns

## 回答 B
最終答案: 150
採用的定義與依據: 語意層未收錄這兩個概念，直接以 customers.signup_date 作為註冊日期，計算 2025 年 3 月的客戶筆數。全部 5000 筆日期皆為 YYYY-MM-DD 格式且無空值，嚴格比對 2025-03-XX 得到 150 筆，與 LIKE 結果一致。
SQL 1: ["SELECT signup_date FROM customers LIMIT 10", "SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025_03 FROM customers WHERE signup_date LIKE '2025-03%'"]
  結果: [{'query': 'SELECT signup_date FROM customers LIMIT 10', 'columns': ['signup_date'], 'rows': [['2025-10-04'], ['2023-06-30'], ['2025-02-05'], ['2025-01-10'], ['2024-06-27'], ['2023-10-26'], ['2023-10-01'], ['2023-10-01'], ['2023-12-14'], ['2024-10-01']], 'truncated': False}, {'query': "SELECT COUNT(
SQL 2: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS iso_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date GLOB '2025-03-[0-9][0-9]' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS strict_2025_03, SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date IS NULL OR signup_date = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS blank_rows FROM customers
  結果: {'columns': ['total', 'iso_rows', 'strict_2025_03', 'blank_rows'], 'rows': [[5000, 5000, 150, 0]], 'truncated': False}

response: {"winner": "tie", "reason": "兩者都以 customers.signup_date 篩選 2025 年 3 月，得到相同答案 150，也都檢查了日期格式與空值（A 用日期範圍加長度與空值檢查，B 用 LIKE 加 GLOB 嚴格比對），定義與驗證程度相當，沒有實質差異。", "critical_error": false}
